song.title: Fell On Black Days (Official Video Version)

guitar.notes: Corrected: Kim Thayil is Soundgarden's guitarist; Chris Cornell was primarily vocalist (occasionally rhythm guitar) so listing him as co-equal guitarist overstates his role. Kim Thayil's Guild S-100 is reasonably well documented.

tone.target: thick drop-D grunge crunch with dry room
tone.profile: thick drop-D grunge crunch with dry room
tone.summary: A powerful signal chain utilizing a Distortion pedal (RAT-style) into an AC30 TB or UK 45 amp model, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab. Compression is used to maintain tightness and punch, while Room reverb provides necessary space without excessive wash.

rig.name: Soundgarden - Fell On Black Days (Official Video Version) - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and maintain signal clarity during heavy riffing.
Slight boost to push the signal into the distortion stage and maintain punch.
Provide the thick, aggressive crunch and mid-heavy bite characteristic of grunge rock.
Tighten the low end and maintain consistent attack for rhythmic riffing.
Simulate the classic Plexi/Marshall tone while providing enough headroom for thick crunch.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound required for grunge rock.
Enhance the mid-range bite and ensure the low end remains tight without muddiness.
Add necessary space and depth (dry room) without excessive wash or reverb-heavy sound.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the current IR for a more aggressive, high-gain 4x12 model suitable for grunge.

proposals.reason: Enhance the aggressive, thick crunch required for Soundgarden's grunge tone.
